input.reasoning_summary: Liquid spilled on laptop causing sticky keys and odd smell is hardware damage that could pose a safety risk and needs physical inspection.

summary.reported: Requester spilled a full cup of coffee on their laptop keyboard; laptop still powers on but some keys are sticky and there is an odd smell.
summary.checked: Confirmed this is a liquid damage case, not a knowledge-base-covered software/config issue.
summary.ruled_out: Not a simple software or peripheral issue; this is physical liquid damage that could pose a safety or further-damage risk if used.
summary.why_escalating: Liquid spills are hardware damage and unsafe to keep using or troubleshoot remotely - needs physical inspection/repair by Field Services. Advise requester in the meantime to power off the device, unplug it, and not attempt to use it until it's inspected.
